thread:
amal_sales: FYI - Prospect Wavecrest Bank asked for an evidence bundle for the POC: SOC 2 summary, copy of ISO cert, signed pen-test attestation (they want Redwood to sign), network diagram (sanitized), KMS separation note, and confirmation of encryption-at-rest. They prefer a downloadable link or direct upload to their secure SharePoint. Need ETA?
reza_se: Are they asking for the full SOC 2 report or a redacted summary? We usually share the summary and SOC 2 carve-out letter.
tess_security: We provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report summary + SOC carve-out letter. ISO cert is a PDF we can share. Regarding pen-test: the external tester signs the official report; we can produce a Redwood attestation stating we commissioned a pen-test on DATE and that critical findings were remediated.
oliver_legal: Confirmed. Legal can approve a standard attestation PDF and e-sign it. If Wavecrest insists on Redwood signing a vendorstyle pen-test letter, clarify they want our attestation vs vendor signature. If they request vendor-signed docs, we will need release from the vendor or the vendor will provide that.
jin_eng: I can generate a sanitized logical diagram + short KMS/key separation note. I recommend we avoid internal hostnames and mask any internal ranges. ETA: I can have drafts in ~18 hours.
compliance-bot: evidence_channel_note: For SharePoint uploads we need an oriented manifest and a signed checksum verification afterwards. Recommended: manifest with sha256, filename patterns, and a single archive object.
amal_sales: Wavecrest prefers SharePoint but said S3 link is fine if that's easier for us. They asked if we can timebox access and provide an allowlist of IPs.
tess_security: We can issue a presigned S3 link with 72h expiry or do SharePoint. If they want IP allowlist, send desired IPs; we can restrict access on our side for the presigned endpoint through a proxy, but SharePoint is under customer control. Chain-of-custody: we will verify manifest checksums and issue a receiving attestation PDF.
reza_se: Also add a short readme that explains what each artifact contains and redaction notes so their reviewers don't ask for raw logs.
amal_sales: Good. Can Legal + Security prepare: (1) Redwood attestation (e-signable), (2) pen-test template for vendor signature, (3) checksum receiving attestation process note? Need to present to buyer this afternoon.
oliver_legal: Will draft the attestation and pen-test template now; can send first pass in a few hours.
tess_security: I'll prepare the checksum/manifest process note and the sanitized diagram template. Jin will drop the diagram samples when ready.
jin_eng: Dropping a sample filename convention for the manifest: `sha256  filename` per line, and recommend `wavecrest_artifacts_v1.zip` as the upload object name.
amal_sales: Thanks team. I'll give the buyer a concise list and offer both SharePoint and S3 upload options. If they pick SharePoint, ask for the upload URL and retention window.
compliance-bot: next_steps: attach manifest template, include example curl command if using presigned URL, confirm DocuSign contact for attestation signing.
amal_sales: I'll update after buyer responds. If they push for vendor-signed pen-test, I'll flag for vendor outreach.
